select max(trade_date) from cynexus_appl_market.futures_position_capture_batch where deleted_at is null and selected is true and status in ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL')
and trade_date <= #{endDate}

with facts as ( select m.rank_type, m.rank_no, m.rank_value, m.rank_change
), totals as ( select sum(rank_value) filter (where rank_type = 'VOLUME' and rank_no <= #{top}) as volume, sum(rank_value) filter (where rank_type = 'LONG' and rank_no <= #{top}) as long_position, sum(rank_value) filter (where rank_type = 'SHORT' and rank_no <= #{top}) as short_position, sum(rank_change) filter (where rank_type = 'LONG' and rank_no <= #{top}) as long_change, sum(rank_change) filter (where rank_type = 'SHORT' and rank_no <= #{top}) as short_change from facts ) select volume, long_position, short_position, long_position - short_position as net_position, long_position / nullif(short_position, 0) as long_short_ratio, long_change, short_change from totals

select trade_date, exchange_code, provider, status, selected, expected_instrument_count, actual_instrument_count, row_count, completed_at from cynexus_appl_market.futures_position_capture_batch where deleted_at is null and trade_date = #{tradeDate} order by exchange_code asc, selected desc, provider asc
